chunks.content: The Company is subject to civil antitrust lawsuits in the U.S. alleging monopolization or attempted monopolization in the markets for its core products. If such investigations or litigation are resolved against the Company, the Company can be exposed to significant fines and may be required to make further changes to its business practices, all of which could materially adversely affect the Company's business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price.

A significant portion of our revenue is concentrated among a small number of large customers. The loss of any of these customers, or a material reduction in their purchases, would significantly reduce our revenue and could materially adversely affect our results of operations, financial condition and stock price.

We depend on a limited number of suppliers for critical components, several of which are single-sourced. Any disruption to these suppliers, including from geopolitical events or natural disasters, could cause significant production delays and increased costs, materially adversely affecting our margins, results of operations, and stock price.

We are currently a defendant in litigation alleging product liability related to one of our flagship products. An adverse outcome could result in substantial monetary damages, injunctive relief limiting our ability to sell the product, and reputational harm, any of which could materially adversely affect our financial condition and stock price.

Our corporate headquarters and several regional offices are leased under long-term agreements. We believe these facilities are generally suitable and adequate for our current needs and do not anticipate difficulty renewing or replacing them as leases expire in the ordinary course of business.

We maintain general liability, property, and workers' compensation insurance policies consistent with industry practice. We periodically review our coverage levels and deductibles with our insurance brokers as part of our routine risk management process.

We publish an annual sustainability report describing our environmental initiatives, including energy usage and waste reduction programs. We have voluntarily adopted internal reporting standards to track our progress on these initiatives over time.

We provide new employees with an onboarding handbook describing internal policies, benefits enrollment procedures, and standard codes of conduct applicable to all staff. These materials are reviewed periodically by our human resources department.
